mapper.select: SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_article a WHERE) AS CHAR) AS article_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_category c WHERE c.status=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blog_article a WHERE a.category_id=c.category_id AND)) AS CHAR) AS category_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_tag t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blog_article_tag x JOIN blog_article a ON a.article_id=x.article_id WHERE x.tag_id=t.tag_id AND)) AS CHAR) AS tag_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_page_view WHERE site_code='blog') AS CHAR) AS page_view_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_page_view WHERE site_code='blog' AND view_time >= #{today} AND view_time < #{tomorrow}) AS CHAR) AS today_page_view_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM blog_page_view WHERE site_code='blog') AS CHAR) AS visitor_count

SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_page_view v WHERE) AS CHAR) AS page_view_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.visitor_id) FROM blog_page_view v WHERE) AS CHAR) AS visitor_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_visitor x WHERE) AS CHAR) AS new_visitor_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_article WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) AS CHAR) AS article_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_article a WHERE) AS CHAR) AS published_article_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_comment WHERE status != 3) AS CHAR) AS comment_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_message WHERE status != 3) AS CHAR) AS message_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_comment WHERE status=0) AS CHAR) AS pending_comment_count, CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_message WHERE status=0) AS CHAR) AS pending_message_count

SELECT DATE(v.view_time) AS date,CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS page_view_count,CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT v.visitor_id) AS CHAR) AS visitor_count FROM blog_page_view v WHERE
GROUP BY DATE(v.view_time) ORDER BY DATE(v.view_time)

SELECT DATE(x.first_visit_time) AS date,CAST(COUNT(*) AS CHAR) AS new_visitor_count,'0' AS cumulative_new_visitor_count FROM blog_visitor x WHERE
GROUP BY DATE(x.first_visit_time) ORDER BY DATE(x.first_visit_time)

SELECT x.province,CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT x.visitor_id) AS CHAR) AS visitor_count FROM blog_visitor x JOIN blog_page_view v ON v.visitor_id=x.visitor_id WHERE
GROUP BY x.province ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT x.visitor_id) DESC,x.province ASC
